---
title: "Simulating Go/No-Go Data"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
---


library(EMC2)

set.seed(123)

factors <- list(
  subjects = paste0("s", 1:20),
  S = c("go", "nogo")
)

dGNG <- design(
  factors = factors,
  model = DDMGNG,
  
  formula = list(
    v  ~ S,
    a  ~ 1,
    t0 ~ 1,
    Z  ~ 1,
    sv ~ 1
  ),
  
  
  Rlevels = c("RESP", "TO"),
  
  functions = list(
    TIMEOUT = function(d) rep(1.5, nrow(d)),
    
    Rnogo = function(d)
      factor(rep("nogo", nrow(d)),
             levels = c("nogo", "go")),
    
    Rgo = function(d)
      factor(rep("go", nrow(d)),
             levels = c("nogo", "go"))
  )
)

# Get the parameters from the model
p_vector <- sampled_pars(dGNG)

# Specify the parameters
p_vector[] <- c(1.5, -2.5, log(1.4), log(0.28), qnorm(0.5), log(0.4))

# Simulate the data
sim_ddm_data <- make_data(
  parameters = p_vector,
  design = dGNG,
  n_trials = 400
)


# FIX RESPONSE VARIABLE
sim_ddm_data$R <- factor(
  ifelse(is.na(sim_ddm_data$rt), "TO", "RESP"),
  levels = c("RESP", "TO")
)

# Print out the stimulus and response combination
(tab <- xtabs(~ S + R, sim_ddm_data))
addmargins(prop.table(tab, 1),2)


sim_ddm_data %>%
  group_by(S) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(rt, na.rm = T),
            min = min(rt, na.rm = T),
            max = max(rt, na.rm = T))
